title: VES Decision Envelope 1.2
description: A portable point-in-time evidence envelope for one consequential organisational decision.

ves_version.description: Pinned VES publication version governing the envelope semantics.

decision_id.description: Opaque identifier for one consequential organisational decision.

decision_type.description: Namespaced classification of the decision under review.

decision_timestamp.description: Point in time at which the organisation committed to the outcome.

decision_subject.description: Opaque subject or matter reference; personal data is not required.

reference.description: Opaque reference retained by the implementing organisation.

outcome.description: Declared organisational outcome and resulting commitment.

commitment.description: Human-readable description of the organisational commitment.

effective_at.description: Time from which the declared outcome takes effect, when distinct from decision_timestamp.

profile.description: VES profile against which the package is declared and assessed.

evidence.description: Native evidence references wrapped as VES External Evidence Objects.

dimensions.description: Separate results for every public VES verification dimension.

extensions.description: Implementation extensions keyed by a controlled namespace; extensions cannot change base VES semantics.

status.description: Assessment status for the submitted package against its stated VES profile; never a rating of the decision outcome or organisation.

summary.description: Declared public summary; sensitive source content may remain external.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence Objects supporting or recording this component.
